We have relevant excerpts from DOC-032 about plan migration effects on integrations. Summarize: moving workspace to new plan does not interrupt existing API keys, webhooks, automation rules—they continue running. The only thing that can change is tier-gated automation feature: if rule uses capability only available on destination tier, it activates after migration; if depends on capability not included, rule is paused (not deleted) and reactivates if tier changes back. Also Settings → Automation → Rules shows status of every rule, including any that migration would pause, before migration is confirmed.

Thus answer: nothing breaks; API keys, webhooks, automation rules keep running; only tier-gated automation features may be paused if not supported in new tier, otherwise they activate. Provide guidance to check Settings → Automation → Rules.

arguments.message: When you migrate a workspace to a different plan, your existing API keys, webhooks and automation rules keep running – they’re tied to the workspace, not the plan tier. The only thing that can be affected is a tier‑gated automation feature: if a rule relies on a capability that isn’t included in the new tier, the rule is paused (not deleted) and will reactivate automatically if you move back to a tier that includes it; if the capability is available in the new tier, the rule activates right after migration. You can see the status of each rule, including any that would be paused, in **Settings → Automation → Rules** before you confirm the migration.
